links.outcome: Accuracy and hallucination of guideline-grounded multiagent system versus general LLMs on guideline questions
links.effect: Guideline-grounded system 90% accuracy vs GPT-4o 48%, Claude 3.7 49%, Gemini 2.5 50%, DeepSeek-R1 58%, ASCO Assistant 67% (all P<.01); no hallucinated answers observed.
links.quote: Most errors were due to incorrect guideline selection or misinterpretation; no hallucinated answers were observed.

unlisted_practices: Multiagent role specialization (coordinator, specialist, reviewer agents) for guideline retrieval and interpretation
Extracting information from tables and figures in guidelines (excluding them reduced accuracy to 51%)

screen.reason: The study develops and benchmarks a multiagent architecture (Tumor Board-Inspired Multiagent AI) against standard LLMs on answering oncology guideline questions. Developing a novel multiagent architecture is considered system/model design rather than testing an operational health deployment practice.
